roles.description: Final human authority for platform-wide governance and high-risk actions.
Maintains registry and governance configuration within delegated scope.
Accountable owner for one or more registered systems.
Performs scoped analysis and implementation on an approved feature branch.
Reviews evidence and changes independently; cannot approve its own implementation.
Can inspect governance records without mutation rights.

separationOfDuties: The actor recorded as implementer cannot be the independent auditor for the same change.
AI roles cannot provide final human approval.
High-risk and destructive actions require explicit Platform Owner approval.
Role assignment changes require an authorized human actor and an audit event.
